subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Private VPC needs + next steps

Hi Sam,

Thanks for taking the time earlier today to walk through NimbleHealth's requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Key requirements: private VPC with no internet egress for model inference, KMS/HSM key management, SOC 2 audit logs, and regional data residency in the US east region
- Expected peak throughput: approx 30 concurrent sessions, burst to 60 for peak batch jobs
- Primary constraints: strict network isolation and audit trail retention for 3 years

Next step: schedule a technical deep-dive / architecture review so our solution architects can review network topology, KMS integration, and deployment sizing. Proposed windows:

- Friday, Jul 10: 10:00 - 11:00 PDT
- Tuesday, Jul 13: 09:00 - 11:00 PDT

Vivek (solutions architect) and Dev (infrastructure lead) will join. You can pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood-tech/30min

Attachments: nimble_vpc_requirements.pdf (from your team), redwood_vpc_arch_overview.pdf (pre-read)

Please confirm which slot works or suggest alternatives

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_arch_overview.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@nimblehealth.com>

Cc: Caroline Jones <caroline.jones@nimblehealth.com>, IT Admin <itadmin@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:40:00-07:00

Hi Marissa,

Really appreciate the concise recap. We are definitely interested in moving forward. A couple notes from our side:

- Jul 10 at 10:00 is close but 10:30 would be easier for our engineering team
- We'll need about 60-90 minutes to cover compliance and networking details
- Caroline Jones (security lead) and our IT admin will join the call

Jul 10, 10:30 - 12:00 PDT would work for us if that fits your team. Otherwise, Jul 13 morning is also possible.

I attached an internal network diagram that may help with the pre-read.

Thanks,

On Thu, Jul 9, 2026 at 9:40 AM Sam Walker <sam.walker@nimblehealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Marissa,
>
> Really appreciate the concise recap...

Thanks Sam. 10:30 - 12:00 PDT on Jul 10 works for our team. We'll plan for a 90-minute session to cover:

- Network topology and connectivity options (peering, private endpoints, transit)
- KMS/HSM integration and key rotation
- Audit logs, retention, and SOC 2 evidence mapping
- Deployment sizing and steady-state throughput expectations
- Deployment and upgrade playbook for on-premises or VPC-hosted private deployment

Dev will lead the sizing and deployment playbook portion, I will cover security and network architecture. I'll create a Google Meet and share a short pre-read folder; please feel free to drop any additional docs there.

Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodVPCPreRead

See you on Friday,
